evidenceScope: Twenty-two unique local mapping routes compared with read-only family-level reference geometry. Dynamic business content was masked before image differencing; raw reference screenshots are not committed.

explainedDifferences.header: The local application intentionally retains the required tenant, organization and warehouse context header.
explainedDifferences.pageHeader: The local route has an explicit page heading; the retained reference evidence is a family-level landing view.
explainedDifferences.queryPanel: Family-level reference evidence does not prove leaf query controls; only dynamic values are privacy-masked.
explainedDifferences.toolbar: Family-level reference evidence does not prove leaf toolbar controls; write actions remain unexecuted.
explainedDifferences.dataGrid: The comparison pairs a real local route with family-level reference structure, so content-region presence is reported but not treated as unexplained.
explainedDifferences.pagination: Pagination is a real local list capability while the family-level reference landing view may omit it.
explainedDifferences.secondaryNavigation: Stable local secondary navigation is intentionally present for support and data-screen routes.
explainedDifferences.workspaceTabs: Stable local workspace tabs are intentionally present for support and data-screen routes.
